query: UPDATE mail_jobs SET state = CASE WHEN state IN ('pending', 'in_progress') THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END, terminal_at = CASE WHEN state IN ('pending', 'in_progress') THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE terminal_at END, nonce = NULL, payload = NULL WHERE user_id = $1 AND authority_kind = $2 AND (state IN ('pending', 'in_progress') OR payload IS NOT NULL)
